title: Inside Sunterra’s Stunning Crystal Lagoon 🌊 | Resort-Style Living in Katy, TX
description:
🌴 Discover the Crystal Lagoon Lifestyle at Sunterra in Katy, TX! 🌊

Step into paradise at the 2.7-acre Crystal Clear Lagoon® in Sunterra, one of the fastest-growing master-planned communities in Katy, Texas! This video gives you an inside look at what it’s like to enjoy resort-style living every single day.

🏖️ Features of Sunterra’s Crystal Lagoon:
✅ White-sand beaches
✅ Crystal-clear swimming areas (up to 3 ft deep)
✅ Kayaking & paddleboarding
✅ Splash zones for the whole family
✅ Lounging areas, shade, and community events
✅ Exclusive access for Sunterra residents

🏡 Beyond the lagoon, Sunterra offers:

The Retreat with a lazy river, resort pool, fitness center & splash pad
Pickleball courts, event lawns, playgrounds, and walking trails
Top-rated Katy ISD schools
Convenient access to I-10 and the Grand Parkway

🌟 Whether you're relocating to Katy or just dreaming of vacation-style living year-round, Sunterra is the place to be.
